```{r}
citeHistory <- function(ct) {
  ct <- ct[order(ct$year), c("year", "cites")]
  ct2 <- ct
  ct2$cites <- cumsum(ct2$cites)
  ct$Type <- "Yearly"
  ct2$Type <- "Cumulative"
  ct <- rbind(ct, ct2)
  ct$Type <- factor(ct$Type, levels = c("Yearly", "Cumulative"))
  ct
}

#### display helpers for the CV's lists ####

## The year in a text date ("February 2019" -> 2019); NA when there is none
## ("Current").
yearOf <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  as.integer(ifelse(grepl("[0-9]{4}", x), sub("^.*?([0-9]{4}).*$", "\\1", x), NA))
}

## A date range for the CV: "2019–2024", "July 2026 – present" (the en dash
## is spaced when either end has a space), a single date when both ends are
## the same ("2018", not "2018 - 2018"), and "present" for an open end
## ("Current" or blank).
dateRange <- function(start, end) {
  start <- trimws(as.character(start))
  end <- trimws(as.character(end))
  end[is.na(end) | !nzchar(end) | tolower(end) %in% c("current", "present")] <- "present"
  sep <- ifelse(grepl(" ", start) | grepl(" ", end), " \u2013 ", "\u2013")
  ## no line break inside a date ("July 2020"), only after the dash
  nb <- function(x) gsub(" ", "\u00a0", x)
  ifelse(is.na(start) | !nzchar(start), nb(end),
         ifelse(start == end, nb(start), paste0(nb(start), sep, nb(end))))
}

## A date or year label at the start of a list item or row
dateSpan <- function(x) sprintf("[%s]{.bml-cv-date}", x)

## Ends a workbook phrase with one full stop: "Elkhart Group Ltd." stays as
## is, and a trailing ";" or "," is dropped rather than followed by ".".
endSentence <- function(x) {
  x <- sub("[;,[:space:]]+$", "", x)
  ifelse(grepl("[.!?]$", x), x, paste0(x, "."))
}

## The workbook's DOIs as links; the workbook itself is left as is. A bare
## "https://doi.org/..." becomes an autolink, and "doi: 10.xxx/yyy" (Software
## sheet) the same link. A full stop or comma after the DOI stays outside it.
linkDois <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("(?<![<(])(https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/[^\\s<>]*[^\\s<>.,;])", "<\\1>", x, perl = TRUE)
  gsub("\\bdoi:\\s*(10\\.[0-9]{4,}/[^\\s<>]*[^\\s<>.,;])", "<https://doi.org/\\1>", x,
       perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
}

## One CV row: a label on the left (a date range, or a year in serif) and
## the entry on the right; stacked on phones. `body` may hold several
## paragraphs or a list.
cvRow <- function(label, body, year = FALSE) {
  paste0("::: {.bml-cv-row}\n",
         if (year) sprintf("[%s]{.bml-cv-year}", label) else dateSpan(label),
         "\n\n", body, "\n:::\n")
}

## A numbered list. The items are markdown, but the list itself is raw HTML
## (<ol>, <li value>) because CV numbering counts down (the newest item has
## the highest number), which a markdown list can't do.
numberedList <- function(num, items) {
  paste0("<ol class=\"bml-cv-list\">\n",
         paste(sprintf("<li value=\"%d\">\n%s\n</li>", num, items), collapse = "\n"),
         "\n</ol>\n")
}

## Link Project names to projects.html, matching the Projects sheet
## case-insensitively (e.g. "SleepCaRe" -> "SleepCare"). Names with no row
## there (HCHS/SOL, POSSUM) still get a link; Joshua chose to leave those as is.
projectNames <- read_excel(cvpath, sheet = "Projects")$Name
projectLinks <- function(x) {
  x2 <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ";")))
  canon <- projectNames[match(tolower(x2), tolower(projectNames))]
  x2 <- fifelse(is.na(canon), x2, canon)
  ## "Project: MYA.", "Projects: ACES and DESTRESS.", "Projects: ACES, DESTRESS and SHS."
  links <- sprintf("[%s](projects.html#%s)", x2, projectAnchor(x2))
  n <- length(links)
  sprintf(" %s: %s.", if (n > 1) "Projects" else "Project",
          if (n > 2) paste0(paste(links[-n], collapse = ", "), " and ", links[n])
          else paste(links, collapse = " and "))
}

## One year of publications or presentations: the year on the left, the
## numbered references (DOIs linked, projects after them) on the right.
printPubs <- function(year, d) {
  dy <- d[Year == year]
  refs <- paste0(linkDois(trimws(dy$Reference)),
                 ifelse(is.na(dy$Project), "", vapply(dy$Project, projectLinks, "")))
  cvRow(year, numberedList(dy$Num, refs), year = TRUE)
}
printAllPubs <- function(d) cat(vapply(unique(d$Year), printPubs, "", d = d), sep = "\n")

## e.g. "**5** primary doctoral students, **4** co-supervised doctoral students,
## **3** Masters students and **1** Honours student", leaving out zero counts;
## each count takes "student" or "students" as it needs
studentCounts <- function(n) {
  n <- n[n > 0]
  x <- sprintf("**%d** %s %s", n, names(n), ifelse(n == 1, "student", "students"))
  if (length(x) > 2) {
    paste0(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), " and ", x[length(x)])
  } else {
    paste(x, collapse = " and ")
  }
}

## SOFTWARE section: each package in the Software sheet, current ones first,
## with its CRAN downloads and latest March percentile rank from SoftwareStats
## when it has them (counts are from Posit's mirror, so a floor)
softwareStats <- tryCatch(as.data.table(read_excel(cvpath, sheet = "SoftwareStats")),
                          error = function(e) NULL)

packageStats <- function(name) {
  if (is.null(softwareStats)) return("")
  d <- softwareStats[Package == name & Metric == "Downloads" & !is.na(Value)]
  r <- softwareStats[Package == name & Metric == "MarchPercentileRank" & !is.na(Value)][order(-Year)]
  parts <- character(0)
  if (nrow(d) > 0) {
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf("&gt;%s CRAN downloads (%s to %s)",
      fmtNum(belowRound(sum(d$Value), 1000)),
      format(min(as.Date(d$From)), "%Y"), format(max(as.Date(d$To)), "%B %Y")))
  }
  if (nrow(r) > 0) {
    ## pool size from the note, e.g. "vs ~25,729 CRAN packages" -> "~25,700"
    pool <- regmatches(r$Notes[1], regexpr("[0-9,]+(?= CRAN packages)", r$Notes[1], perl = TRUE))
    pool <- if (length(pool) == 1 && !is.na(pool)) {
      sprintf("~%s ", fmtNum(100 * floor(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", pool)) / 100)))
    } else ""
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf("March %d: on average more daily downloads than %.1f%% of %sCRAN packages%s",
      r$Year[1], r$Value[1], pool, if (isTRUE(r$Partial[1] == 1)) " (partial month)" else ""))
  }
  if (length(parts) == 0) "" else
    sprintf('\n\n[%s.]{.bml-meta}', paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}

## Package names link to CRAN only while the package is on CRAN; otherwise to
## the first GitHub address in its Info text. The site never checks CRAN
## itself, so archived packages are listed here: varian was archived from
## CRAN on 2026-05-15 (remove it from this list if it returns).
cranArchived <- c("varian")
onCRAN <- setdiff(if (is.null(softwareStats)) character(0) else unique(softwareStats$Package),
                  cranArchived)
packageLink <- function(name, info) {
  gh <- regmatches(info, regexpr("https?://github\\.com/[^[:space:]]+[^[:space:].,;]", info))
  if (name %in% onCRAN) sprintf("[%s](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=%s)", name, name)
  else if (length(gh) == 1) sprintf("[%s](%s)", name, gh)
  else name
}

  ## labs(caption = "Data from Clarivate JCR.\nBenchmarks are aspirational levels for Teaching & Research faculty at Monash University.") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(2013 - .5, cyear + .5),
                  ylim = c(pmin(.5, min(dq1$PQ1)), 1.07),
                  expand = FALSE)

#### charts shown on the page ####
## Built with plot_ly rather than ggplotly so they suit phones: titles sit in
## the page (never cut off), the plotly axes pick as many year labels as fit,
## the legend wraps above the plot, and dragging scrolls the page instead of
## zooming. Colours are slots 1-3 of the validated categorical palette in the
## dataviz skill (blue, orange, aqua: colour-blind safe as neighbours); the
## table under the charts gives every value.
chartCols <- c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a")
chartFont <- list(family = "Manrope, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif",
                  size = 13, color = "#16222e")
chartAxis <- function(...) {
  modifyList(list(showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, showline = TRUE, linecolor = "#e3dfd7",
                  ticks = "", tickfont = list(size = 12, color = "#5a6570"),
                  fixedrange = TRUE, automargin = TRUE, title = list(text = "")),
             list(...))
}
cvChart <- function(p, ytitle, legend = TRUE, barmode = NULL) {
  p <- layout(p,
    font = chartFont, paper_bgcolor = "#ffffff", plot_bgcolor = "#ffffff",
    margin = list(l = 8, r = 12, t = if (legend) 4 else 16, b = 8, pad = 4),
    xaxis = chartAxis(tickformat = "d", hoverformat = "d"),
    yaxis = chartAxis(showline = FALSE, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#efebe4",
                      tickformat = ",d", rangemode = "tozero",
                      title = list(text = ytitle, standoff = 10,
                                   font = list(size = 12, color = "#5a6570"))),
    showlegend = legend,
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, xanchor = "left", y = 1.02, yanchor = "bottom",
                  font = list(size = 12, color = "#16222e"), traceorder = "normal",
                  itemclick = FALSE, itemdoubleclick = FALSE),
    hovermode = "x unified",
    hoverlabel = list(font = chartFont, bgcolor = "#ffffff", bordercolor = "#e3dfd7"),
    dragmode = FALSE, bargap = .4, barmode = barmode)
  config(p, displayModeBar = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, scrollZoom = FALSE,
         doubleClick = FALSE, showTips = FALSE)
}
## a running total as a 2px line with a dot at its end; `label` (optional)
## is written above the end dot, `legend` is the name in the legend
chartLine <- function(p, x, y, name, col, label = NULL, legend = name) {
  n <- length(y)
  add_trace(p, x = x, y = y, name = legend, type = "scatter",
            mode = if (is.null(label)) "lines+markers" else "lines+markers+text",
            line = list(color = col, width = 2),
            marker = list(color = col, size = c(rep(0, n - 1), 9),
                          line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = c(rep(0, n - 1), 2))),
            text = if (!is.null(label)) c(rep("", n - 1), label),
            textposition = "top left", textfont = list(color = "#16222e", size = 12),
            hovertemplate = paste0(name, ": %{y:,d}<extra></extra>"))
}

## publications per year in the Academic Summary's groups
chartYears <- seq(min(pubs$Year), max(pubs$Year))
pubGroups <- c("Peer-reviewed articles", "Other publications", "Books")
pubByYear <- pubs[, .(Group = fcase(Type %in% c("Empirical", "Review"), pubGroups[1],
                                    Type == "Book", pubGroups[3],
                                    default = pubGroups[2]), Year)]
pubByYear <- dcast(pubByYear[, .N, by = .(Year, Group)][CJ(Year = chartYears, Group = pubGroups),
                                                       on = .(Year, Group)][is.na(N), N := 0L],
                   Year ~ Group, value.var = "N")
pubByYear[, Total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = pubGroups]

pubYearChart <- plot_ly(height = 340)
for (i in seq_along(pubGroups)) {
  pubYearChart <- add_trace(pubYearChart, x = pubByYear$Year, y = pubByYear[[pubGroups[i]]],
    name = pubGroups[i], type = "bar",
    marker = list(color = chartCols[i], line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 1)),
    hovertemplate = paste0(pubGroups[i], ": %{y}<extra></extra>"))
}
pubYearChart <- cvChart(pubYearChart, "Publications", barmode = "stack")

pubTotalChart <- plot_ly(height = 340) |>
  add_trace(x = pubByYear$Year, y = cumsum(pubByYear$Total), type = "scatter", mode = "none",
            fill = "tozeroy", fillcolor = "rgba(42, 120, 214, .1)", hoverinfo = "skip",
            showlegend = FALSE) |>
  chartLine(pubByYear$Year, cumsum(pubByYear$Total), "Publications in total", chartCols[1],
            fmtNum(sum(pubByYear$Total))) |>
  cvChart("Publications in total", legend = FALSE)

## citations per year, both sources (CLAUDE.md: show Google Scholar and Scopus)
citeByYear <- if (length(citeSources)) {
  ct <- rbindlist(lapply(citeSources, function(x) data.table(x$byYear, Source = x$source)))
  dcast(ct, year ~ Source, value.var = "cites")
}
citeAsOf <- if (length(citeSources)) max(do.call(c, lapply(citeSources, `[[`, "asOf")), na.rm = TRUE)
citeYearChart <- citeTotalChart <- NULL
if (!is.null(citeByYear)) {
  srcs <- intersect(c("Google Scholar", "Scopus"), names(citeByYear))
  citeYearChart <- plot_ly(height = 340)
  citeTotalChart <- plot_ly(height = 340)
  for (i in seq_along(srcs)) {
    y <- citeByYear[[srcs[i]]]
    keep <- !is.na(y)
    citeYearChart <- add_trace(citeYearChart, x = citeByYear$year[keep], y = y[keep], name = srcs[i],
      type = "bar", marker = list(color = chartCols[i]),
      hovertemplate = paste0(srcs[i], ": %{y:,d}<extra></extra>"))
    ## the end values go in the legend: labels by the line ends would collide
    citeTotalChart <- chartLine(citeTotalChart, citeByYear$year[keep], cumsum(y[keep]),
                                srcs[i], chartCols[i],
                                legend = sprintf("%s (%s)", srcs[i], fmtNum(sum(y[keep]))))
  }
  citeYearChart <- cvChart(citeYearChart, "Citations", barmode = "group")
  citeTotalChart <- cvChart(citeTotalChart, "Citations in total")
}

## the charts' numbers as two tables (their text equivalent), newest first
mdTable <- function(d, heads) {
  d <- as.data.frame(d)
  num <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", fmtNum(x))
  rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) {
    paste(c(d[[1]][i], vapply(d[i, -1], num, "")), collapse = " | ")
  }, "")
  paste(c(paste("|", paste(heads, collapse = " | "), "|"),
          paste0("|", paste(c(":--", rep("--:", length(heads) - 1)), collapse = "|"), "|"),
          paste("|", rows, "|")), collapse = "\n")
}
chartTableMd <- paste0(
  mdTable(pubByYear[order(-Year), c("Year", pubGroups, "Total"), with = FALSE],
          c("Year", "Articles", "Other", "Books", "All")),
  "\n\n: Publications by year. Articles are peer-reviewed empirical and review articles.\n",
  if (!is.null(citeByYear)) paste0(
    "\n",
    mdTable(citeByYear[order(-year), c("year", srcs), with = FALSE], c("Year", srcs)),
    "\n\n: Citations by year.\n"))
chartYearNow <- max(chartYears)

```
